tagline.en: The Loop — Houston's first ring road, and now its inner one
tagline.zh: 610 环线：休斯敦第一条环路，如今的内环

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

en: I-610 is a closed ring of about thirty-eight miles around inner Houston, known locally by quadrant: the North, East, South and West Loops. The even hundreds digit marks it as a loop off I-10, which it meets twice. Inside it are downtown, the Texas Medical Center, Rice University and the Uptown–Galleria district; the East Loop runs through the refineries and terminals of the Houston Ship Channel. Like Atlanta's Perimeter, the road has become a social boundary as much as a traffic one — Houstonians say inside the Loop and mean something about the city, not about a road.

The West Loop past the Galleria is the congested half and has been since the shopping centre opened in 1970 and set off a building boom beside the freeway. The East Loop is the industrial half, and it carries the Sidney Sherman Bridge over the Ship Channel: ten lanes, a 600-foot main span and 135 feet of clearance for ships. The National Bridge Inventory records about 136,576 vehicles a day across it, and rates its deck satisfactory with the superstructure and substructure both fair.
zh: I-610 是环绕休斯敦内城、周长约三十八英里的闭合环线，当地人按象限称呼它：北环、东环、南环、西环。偶数百位表明它是 I-10 的环线，二者两次相交。环内是市中心、得克萨斯医学中心、莱斯大学和上城—伽利略购物中心一带；东环则穿过休斯敦航道沿线的炼油厂与码头。与亚特兰大的环城线一样，这条路既是交通边界，也成了社会边界——休斯敦人说「环内」，指的是这座城市的某种属性，而不是一条路。
经过伽利略购物中心的西环是拥堵的那一半，自 1970 年该购物中心开业、在高速旁引发建设热潮以来一直如此。东环是工业的那一半，其上有跨越航道的悉尼·谢尔曼大桥：十车道，主跨 600 英尺，桥下净空 135 英尺供船舶通行。美国国家桥梁清单记录该桥日均通行约 136,576 辆，桥面状况评为「尚可」，上部结构与下部结构均为「一般」。

en: A bypass around Houston was first proposed in 1931 and first formally studied in 1941, the year Harris County voters approved a bond for what was then called the Defense Loop — a route to move troops and materiel around the city rather than through it. It was designated Loop 137 in 1942; the war stopped everything. The West and South Loops were approved as freeways in October 1954, the first freeway section opened in 1960, and Houston's first four-level interchange was completed where the West Loop meets the Southwest Freeway in 1962.

The east side was the last and hardest part, because it had to cross the Ship Channel. Construction of the 6,300-foot, ten-lane bridge began in October 1968; the main span was widened to 600 feet at the insistence of the Army Corps of Engineers, which judged the original 400-foot design a hazard to shipping. The bridge and the East Loop opened on 2 March 1973, and the ring finally closed on 22 September 1975 with a short section on the north-east side. The total cost of the loop was $169,423,000.
zh: 绕开休斯敦的外环最早在 1931 年被提出，1941 年首次正式研究，同年哈里斯县选民通过了为当时所谓「国防环线」发行债券的表决——这条路的用意是让部队和物资绕城而行，而不是穿城而过。1942 年它被定名为 137 号环线；随后战争让一切停摆。西环与南环于 1954 年 10 月获批按高速公路标准建设，第一段高速于 1960 年通车，休斯敦第一座四层立交也于 1962 年在西环与西南高速交汇处建成。
东侧是最后、也最难的一段，因为它必须跨越航道。这座 6,300 英尺长、十车道的大桥于 1968 年 10 月动工；主跨在陆军工程兵团的坚持下从原设计的 400 英尺加宽到 600 英尺，理由是原方案对航运构成危险。大桥与东环于 1973 年 3 月 2 日通车，整个环线则在 1975 年 9 月 22 日随东北侧一小段的开通而最终合拢。全环总造价为 169,423,000 美元。

timeline.en: Harris County voters approve a bond for the Defense Loop, the ancestor of I-610.
timeline.zh: 哈里斯县选民通过为「国防环线」发行债券，此即 I-610 的前身。

timeline.en: The first freeway section of the loop opens, on the North Loop.
timeline.zh: 环线的第一段高速在北环通车。

timeline.en: The Sidney Sherman Bridge carries the East Loop over the Houston Ship Channel.
timeline.zh: 悉尼·谢尔曼大桥建成，东环由此跨越休斯敦航道。

timeline.en: A short north-east section closes the ring, 34 years after the bond vote.
timeline.zh: 东北侧一小段通车使环线合拢，距债券表决已过去 34 年。
